- **The changeset:** `patch` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (a team record's served page stops listing a related list whose only action acts on the caller's own sessions; it owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review on the narrowing face before the queue)
Responsibility: an administrator on a team record is offered an action that signs out their own other devices | `sys_session.active_team_id` derives a team-side related list | every administrator who opens a team

PR #24791, which the lane note named, merged at 2026-10-20T07:28Z, so no open PR touches `sys-session.object.ts`.
